newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Sitix ask-only on downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Sitix ask-only on downgrade.

text.p: Shares in Sumitomo Sitix Corp were ask-only on Monday morning, depressed by a major securities house's downgrading of the manufacturer of metallic titanium, traders said.
The share price stood ask-only at 2,410 yen at 0050 GMT, down from Friday's close of 2,490.
The shares were trading 130 yen lower at 2,360 at 0410 GMT. Turnover was 422,000 shares.
Early in the morning, Yamaichi Research Institute of Securities and Economics Inc said it had downgraded Sumitomo Sitix to a "2" rating from its previous "1".
